newsitem.title: USA: NEBRASKA FED CATTLE SALES NOT WELL DEVELOPED -USDA.
newsitem.headline: NEBRASKA FED CATTLE SALES NOT WELL DEVELOPED -USDA.

text.p: Trading on slaughter steers and heifers was not well developed, but reprsentative dressed basis sales were steady to $1.00 per cwt lower, USDA said. Buyer inquiry fair. Seller interest uneven.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1300 lbs - 105.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1125-1175 lbs - 105.00.
